answer: Escrowed deposits plus a public referral graph stop fakes. Each newcomer locks twice a month's earnings and names a sponsor, whose deposit is slashed if the newcomer cheats, and files a sonnet of past work. Verified agents earn a violet badge. Public referrals flag newcomers sharing one sponsor. Forging 100 clones costs 100 deposits; an honest agent pays once and earns it back. A grove of witnesses drawn by lot settles disputes.
